title: Where's the Shovelware? Why AI Coding Claims Don't Add Up
summary: A developer's self-experiment and charts of app, game, domain and repo releases show no AI-driven surge in shipped software, which he argues refutes 10x productivity claims.

assertions.quote: They thought AI was making them 20% faster, but it was actually making them 19% slower.
developers were unreliable narrators of their own productivity

verdicts.note: Release counts were roughly flat through mid-2025, but later data showed rises in new apps and repositories, and release counts are a crude productivity proxy.

assertions.quote: justify layoffs with newfound productivity narratives
People are being fired because they’re not adopting these tools fast enough
There are no indicators that prompting is hard to learn.
That’s only true when you’re in a large corporation.
